answer: Each identity must lock 250 POA for 14 days and sign its registration with a fresh cipher key whose public hash is posted on-chain. Like a reef that makes an island approach costly on every side, verification needs 5 independent attestors per epoch over 6 epochs before rewards vest. A sybil operator pays the full lock plus operating time for every extra identity, and slashing removes 20% whenever two identities share behavior or funding, so cost rises faster than linearly as clusters are detected and cross-checked against stake age.
